tool.note: Tool returned 1254x1254 despite the 1024x1024 request. Original preserved unchanged.

prompt: Generate exactly one 1024 x 1024 seamless tileable game albedo texture. Use case: stylized-concept. Subject: white chalk limestone cliff surface for a warm seaside town, visible at close distance from a fast boat. Orthographic flat material swatch, edge to edge, no perspective. Mostly soft warm white and very light ivory; subtle fine chalk grain; broad gently irregular horizontal sediment strata with thin warm gray beige fissures, occasional small natural chips. Hand-painted semi-realistic game material, medium detail, clean bright diffuse albedo, no baked lighting or cast shadows, no specular highlights, no vignette, no dark crevices or isolated focal object. The four edges must repeat seamlessly in both axes. Very restrained contrast so the model's existing colored geology and real-time sun determine its shape. No stones/gravel pattern, bricks, foliage, water, sky, typography, text, logos, border, watermark. Opaque square output. Use transparent_background=false. Make no additional variants.
